main.description: A Massachusetts legislature bill mirrored into an ATProto repo. Record key convention: '{court}-{billId}' (e.g. '193-H1234'), which consumers must treat as opaque — court and billId are carried as fields precisely so nothing has to parse the key. Testimony aggregates (counts, latest testimony) belong to an AppView and full document text belongs in blob storage; neither is in the record.

billId.description: Bill identifier within the court, e.g. 'H1234'. The upstream API repeats this inside the document as BillNumber; it is carried once, here.

similar.description: Bill ids the legislature reports as similar. Upstream data, not an AppView computation.

city.description: City name, for city council bills.

hearingIds.description: hearingId of each org.mapletestimony.hearing record whose agendas list this bill. Upstream EventIds, deliberately not an AppView's document ids: a consumer joins on the hearing record's own identity and never has to know how MAPLE keys its database.

nextHearingId.description: hearingId of the soonest upcoming hearing. This field, hearingIds and nextHearingAt are joins computed from the hearing records rather than fetched from the legislature; they are in the record because the publisher can compute them and a consumer cannot cheaply.

fetchedAt.description: When this bill was last fetched from the upstream legislature API.

billContent.description: Bill content as published by the legislature, minus what is carried on the record itself (BillNumber, GeneralCourtNumber) and minus DocumentText, which is too large for a record and would be a blob. Only Title and Cosponsors are guaranteed by the upstream API; everything else is optional here because it is nullable or absent there.

pinslip.description: The petition text as published. Typically short — measured across 7056 real pinslips: p50 224, p99 531 — but with a long tail where a petition names every signatory, and 20 bills exceed 2000 with a maximum of 28049. This is the field that governs how large a bill record can get; 50000 leaves headroom over the observed maximum while keeping the worst case around a third of the PDS's 150 KiB request cap.

memberReference.description: A bill sponsor. Only name and memberType are guaranteed: the upstream API returns a null Id for every Public Request (memberType 3) and Special Request (memberType 4) sponsor — private citizens and agencies petitioning, who have no legislative member record to point at — and occasionally for a legislator too. Measured across 7337 real bill documents: 535/535 type-3, 63/63 type-4, 48/51056 type-1 and 8/392 type-2 references carry no Id.

memberType.description: 1 = Legislative Member, 2 = Committee, 3 = Public Request, 4 = Special Request.

date.description: Upstream legislature date string, preserved verbatim. Not format=datetime: the upstream API emits timestamps without timezone offsets, which ATProto's datetime validation rejects.
